answer: The horizon explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Splitting into 9 separate vaults needs a separate funded echo account and a separate escrow deposit for each, so that the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the river binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 497 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
